mobdefense.name: Propwash: Mob Defense
mobdefense.description: Accessories that let your drone fight mobs: dispenser in front, spear below, rocket booster on top. Hostile mobs fight back.
mobdefense.help.dispenser_mount.summary: Dispenser Mount – four slots, fires forward
mobdefense.help.spear_mount.summary: Spear Mount – carries one spear under the drone
mobdefense.help.rocket_booster.summary: Rocket Booster – one firework rocket for a boost
gamerule.mobdefense.mobs_react_to_drones: Hostile mobs notice flying drones and fight back: zombies come closer, skeletons shoot, phantoms hunt. Off: mobs ignore drones.
gamerule.mobdefense.mob_reaction_range.d: Distance in blocks within which mobs notice a drone.
gamerule.mobdefense.mob_damage_to_drones: Damage mobs deal to drones, in percent of the normal value (0 = none, 400 = four times).
gamerule.mobdefense.payloads_hit_players: Harmful payloads (projectiles, harmful potions, spear, TNT damage) hit players. Healing and other positive potions always work; vanilla PvP still applies.
gamerule.mobdefense.allow_tnt.descriptio: The dispenser mount may drop primed TNT. Off: the dispenser refuses TNT.
gamerule.mobdefense.drone_griefing.descr: Payloads may change blocks: TNT damage, fire from fire charges and flint and steel, placed blocks and fluids. Vanilla tnt_explodes still applies.
Water, lava and powder snow buckets and buckets with fish or animals may place their contents. Off: the dispenser refuses them, empty buckets still scoop.
gamerule.mobdefense.real_ammo.descriptio: Every shot uses up one item. Off: the slot must be filled, but the item stays.
gamerule.mobdefense.dispenser_cooldown_t: Ticks between two shots of the dispenser mount (20 ticks = 1 s, vanilla dispenser: 4).
gamerule.mobdefense.spear_damage_percent: Share of the vanilla spear damage that the spear mount deals, in percent.
